title: WebGL2 - Web Worker OffscreenCanvas getContext('webgl2')
product-requirement: Terminals MUST implement WebGL v2 and permit obtaining WebGL2RenderingContext in web workers
specification: Terminals MUST implement WebGL v2 and permit a visible BBC application (web worker) to obtain WebGL2RenderingContext via OffscreenCanvas object's getContext API ('webgl2' context identifier)
assertion: OffscreenCanvas.getContext('webgl2') returns a valid WebGL2RenderingContext in a web worker

changelog.summary: Initial creation of WebGL2 context test for OffscreenCanvas in web worker
